Android does keep a log, but it's deleted the moment you complete the game, and it's not linked to in the app, so you have to know where to find it.  (I use ES File Explorer, which automatically shows you newly-created files, which makes it easier.)  So right before you make the winning move, you have to go make a copy of the file first.

iOS keeps a log, too, but I don't believe there's any way of getting to it unless your device is jailbroken.
